statement: TSMC reported July 2026 revenue of about NT$467.58 billion, up 5.6% from June 2026 and up 44.7% from July 2025.
why: TSMC's monthly revenue is the earliest hard read on whether accelerator wafers are actually shipping, weeks ahead of any chip vendor's results.

impact.mechanism: Accelerating foundry revenue indicates rising wafer output for AI accelerators, expanding upstream supply and confirming order flow from chip designers.

evidence.excerpt: July 2026 revenue was approximately NT$467.58 billion, an increase of 5.6 percent from June 2026, and an increase of 44.7 percent from July 2025.
Cumulative revenue for January through July 2026 was NT$2,872.06 billion (approximately NT$2.87 trillion), representing an increase of 37.0 percent compared to the same period in 2025.

confidence.basis: Fetched as a secondary-tier document; the figures are TSMC's official monthly disclosure but no primary filing was captured, and the record-month framing comes from press coverage.
